title: Delivery milestone record frontmatter (milestone-v1)
description: Shape of one docs/streams/<stream>/milestones/m-<NN>-<slug>.md record's frontmatter, as statusgen's milestone loader enforces it (spec/milestone-v1.md §2-§3). Identity and version come only from milestone and contract-version, never from the filename. Ownership, alias normalization, duplicate versions, coverage and provenance are the loader's cross-record rules, not expressible here.

milestone.description: Full colon-only <cell>:<repo>:<stream>:m-<NN>; the earlier draft <cell>:<repo>:<stream>/m-<NN> spelling is a compatibility input. No version selector.

contributes.description: Brief references with an optional exact authored-revision selector; empty only for an existing capability whose criteria all cite evidence.

requires-milestones.description: Exact milestone-version references; empty explicitly means none.
